claims.text: Role in cor pulmonale: tx is directed at the cause;
claims.quote: Treatment of right heart failure consists of identifying and treating the underlying cause.
claims.locator: Treatment of Right Heart Failure and Cor Pulmonale › Treatment of cause

claims.text: acute causes incl massive pulmonary embolization.
When the cause is acute PE: initial, then maintenance anticoagulation is indicated (prevents further embolization and new clot);
claims.quote: Initial anticoagulation followed by maintenance anticoagulation is indicated for patients with acute pulmonary embolism to prevent further embolization as well as new clot formation.

claims.text: initial choices incl IV UFH and SC LMWH.
claims.quote: Initial anticoagulation choices for acute PE include Intravenous unfractionated heparin Subcutaneous low molecular weight heparin

claims.text: PLT: check b4 and periodically during heparin;
claims.quote: Obtain platelet counts before and periodically during heparin therapy.

claims.text: thrombocytopenia occurs in up to 30%, 2–20 days (avg 5–9) after starting.
claims.quote: Thrombocytopenia in patients receiving heparin has been reported at frequencies up to 30%. It can occur 2 to 20 days (average 5 to 9) following the onset of heparin therapy.

claims.text: If PLT fall below 100,000 or thrombosis recurs, stop heparin and evaluate for HIT;
claims.quote: If the count falls below 100,000/mm 3 or if recurrent thrombosis develops, promptly discontinue heparin, evaluate for HIT and HITT

claims.text: HIT can occur up to several wks after heparin = stopped.
claims.quote: HIT or HITT can occur up to several weeks after the discontinuation of heparin therapy.
claims.locator: 5.3 Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia and Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia and Thrombosis

claims.text: which may cause long-term or permanent paralysis.
